design.summary: Route observatory requests by deskPhase and domeState through the existing semantic runtime. Keep compact loading and single broader retry as-is, add explicit phase routing on top, and defer caching or model changes until tested. Loaded prompts remain the source for action names and safety text.

techniques.title: Compact context load
techniques.why: The shared bundle already loads only needed rules for wind, confirmation, and target versus technician selection.
techniques.implementation: Continue using runtime.json plus loader.runtime_request for assembly. No new loader. Keep manifest.json as source of truth for shared set.
techniques.risk: Compact slice can miss a needed rule if routing is wrong, requiring the approved broader retry.
techniques.validation: Test roster-collection vs target-selection, wind interlock present, and confirmation expiry cases.

techniques.title: Dependency closure plus one broader retry
techniques.why: Runtime already resolves shared dependencies and allows ONE broader pre-generation expansion when compact context is insufficient.
techniques.implementation: Use existing runtime closure in loader.py and run.py. Do not add custom expansion. Pass intent and require_rule_ids through when supplied.
techniques.risk: Repeated retries would add input cost; limit to the one approved expansion.
techniques.validation: Test missing-rule fallback, hash check failure stops, and unresolved state stops without bypass.

techniques.title: Phase-based routing on deskPhase
techniques.why: R2 requires different actions for the same name by phase: select_target versus select_technician, plus confirmation before slew.
techniques.implementation: In templates/project_adapter.py add resolve_intent(context) mapping deskPhase target-selection to target workflow and roster-collection to roster workflow, then call loader.runtime_request once with that intent. If deskPhase is missing ask for clarification.
techniques.risk: Wrong or missing deskPhase routes to wrong action; default must be clarification not guess.
techniques.validation: Test each deskPhase value, missing deskPhase, domeState closed notice, and confirmation scoping.

techniques.title: Defer caching until measured
techniques.why: Caching needs live traffic validation and must not change safety text from R1 and R3.
techniques.implementation: No code change now. Later measure with run.py input/output and cache use before any adoption.
techniques.risk: Stale cache could serve expired confirmation or old safety text.
techniques.validation: Requires paired live tests for correctness, input/output use, and response time.

assumptions: Equal request share across listed workflow modules; replace with your traffic mix.
Token counts approximate instruction characters / 4, with a 3–5 characters/token range. They are not Meta token counts.
Fallback scenario adds a broader retry after a compact attempt; actual pre-generation expansion can cost less.
Shared rules, approved dependency closure, routing overhead and approved reference lengths are included.
User messages, tools, full message envelope, generated/reasoning output, cache discounts and optimization setup cost are excluded.
This is an input-cost scenario at the same model/rate; accuracy, total cost and speed improvements require paired live tests.
nextTests: Identical expected action, entities and final state
